about: SIGNED baselines for the world master gate (KPC owner, 2026-11-11; owner OK Nov 11, numbers at the manager's discretion). The gate (kpc_master_cli.py gate --approved) reads ONLY this file and checks each listed copy EXACTLY against expected_count, and only for the one W-XX.json.gz whose sha256 is copy_sha256 (any other copy of that country falls back to the layers.json baseline). Each sha256 was computed from the boundary-cache release asset (it equals the release page digest); each count is that copy's record count (kpc_master_cli.py bundle-manifest --show) and equals the gate's 'read N' line in run 43082247085. Every record the current key joins or lists as a candidate, for each layer the copy holds, is in the copy (checked by layer + record id). Not signed, kept held: see not_signed.
